responsibility: Describes unconditional and call-control transfer patterns for the M32C backend, including direct and indirect jumps, calls with and without return values, and untyped calls. It selects different sequences for A16 versus A24 parts, handles special-page vector calls and memory-indirect call forms, and supplies the RTL-to-assembly mappings that drive branch and subroutine control transfer outside the compare/conditional logic kept in cond.md.
